svg.title: HealthReader 健康数据同步 — launcher icon
svg.desc: Flat minimal: a teal heart-rate pulse inside an open clockwise sync ring on a pale teal field. Design source for the Android adaptive icon; the foreground art sits inside the central 66x66 safe zone (also inside the 66dp safe circle), and the outer area is mask bleed. Geometry is identical to res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml scaled from the 108x108 adaptive-icon viewport by 512/108.
